## Ctx.callbackQueryAnswer() method

Answers a callback query with an optional notification.

**Signature:**

```typescript
callbackQueryAnswer(options?: Parameters<typeof Ctx.prototype.ct.answerCallbackQuery>[0]): Promise<true | null>;
```

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;true \| null&gt;

True if the answer was sent, or null on error.

## Remarks

Should be called in callback handlers to acknowledge the callback query. Errors are silently caught and return null.

## Example


```typescript
async callbackPayload() {
  await this.callbackQueryAnswer({text: "Action completed!"})
  await this.edit()
}
```
